**Finding: deviation (high severity, ASSIGN)**

The planner hint suggested no assignment clause existed, but one does — buried as clause 10 inside Section 7 (`p0042`).

**What's there:** A mutual, symmetrical consent requirement on any assignment, transfer or subcontract, softened by a "not unreasonably withheld" standard.

**Why it deviates:**
- No carve-out letting Clear Capital assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets — our internal reorganizations and exit events would require RadialSpark's consent.
- No bar on RadialSpark assigning the Agreement to one of our competitors.

**What's already fine:** Section 6 termination rights (`p0032`, `p0033`) are purely notice- and breach-based, and a document-wide search for "change of control" returned nothing. So there is no Vendor termination or re-pricing trigger on our change of control — this stays clear of the walk-away line, as does the reasonable-consent standard.

**Redline (validated ok:true):** A single appended proviso to `p0042` that (i) permits Company assignment without consent to an affiliate or M&A successor, (ii) confirms a change of control of Company is not deemed an assignment and gives Contractor no termination, suspension or re-pricing right, and (iii) prohibits Contractor assignment to a Company competitor. The existing sentence is otherwise untouched — only the closing period is replaced, keeping the edit minimal.

The comment flags the notice-based mutual successor right as an available fallback if RadialSpark resists the consent-free carve-out.
